messages:
tess: IRL poll — if we could add one permanent, silly object to the office fridge that everyone must interact with at least once a week, what would you pick? (non-work, low-effort, bonus points for chaos) :grin:
mika: A polaroid wall. Everyone snaps a pic of their lunch and sticks it. Absolute chaos. :camera:
jamal: An actual 'fridge fortune cookie' dispenser that prints a tiny message when you open the door. 10/10 for morale.
olivia: Motion-activated kazoo that plays 2 bars when you open it. Low volume, high morale. :musical_note:
kitchen-bot: Heads-up: please label anything you add to communal spaces. Fridge rules still apply. :clipboard:
tess: @mika love the polaroid idea. jamal's fortune printer could be next to it.
mika: also a 'leftovers adoption board' like an animal shelter for Tupperwares. People claim them. :paw_prints:
jamal: we should have a 'mystery jar' where people put one weird snack and whoever opens it must try it. Consent required. :eyes:
olivia: vote: polaroid wall 🗳️ kazoo 🎺 fortune-printer 🥠 mystery-jar 🥫 leftovers-board 🗂️
tess: +1 polaroid from me. kazoo is my runner-up. If this gets 5 reactions we install a sticky note sign. :thumbsup:
mika: if the polaroid wall happens i'm bringing a tiny whiteboard marker for captions. chaos curated. :sparkles:
